Grapes are field crops unlocked at experience level 84.

They were introduced on December 12th, 2016, along with Bananas

They are used to make banana bread, dried fruits, fruit cakes, goat cheese toasts, grape jam, grape juice and plum smoothies.

Like all crops, they are stored in the silo.

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for 480 coin.

Growing grapes

Grapes are grown in fields by planting another grape (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 6 experience points, and takes 3 hours to mature.

Selling grapes

  • Grapes can be bought or sold for a maximum price of 324 coin for 10 bunches.

Using grapes

Grapes are used to make the following products:

Boat orders

Boat orders ask for 11 to 16 grapes per crate, up to a total of 52 per boat.

Strategy tips

  • Grapes are rare enough that selling them at maximum price is recommended.
  • Recipes ask for 2 to 3 bunches of grapes so you need to have several extra bushes to cover your needs. Extras can also be useful if you have boats with grape crates although you have time to harvest some.
